ghi_chu: SUA LOI BO CHAY SAU KHI DOI DI MUA BINH. Khi mot acc het binh, ca doi rut ra cua ra party de no di mua — dung thiet ke. Nhung co 'thoi danh' dat luc do mang dung nhan 'user da roi bai', ma luoi an toan lai co y chua nhan do ra (vi y muon user thi phai ton trong). Ket qua: mua binh xong ve bai van bo chay khoi moi tran, 21 lan trong 25 phut. Nay phan biet theo DUONG GOI: viec nen thi go duoc, chi nut Roi bai va Stop moi giu co.
